subject: English
question_text: Choose the correct answer from the alternatives: 1 7=7
stimulus: i. What day should white clothes be washed according to the instructions? A) Tuesday B) Monday C) Wednesday D) Friday ii. Where should color clothes be dried? A) On a stone heap B) On the clothesline C) On the bed D) On the roof iii. What should you avoid when buying cotton for a blouse? A) Wrinkles B) Holes C) Gum in the fabric D) Loose threads iv. How should pumpkin fritters be cooked? A) In warm water B) In cold oil C) In very hot sweet oil D) In a pressure cooker V. What must be done to salt fish before cooking it? A) Fry it directly B) Boil it C) Dry it D) Soak it overnight Vi. What is benna, in the context of the passage? A) A kind of fruit B) A type of song C) A clothing item D) A tool Vii. Where is benna not appropriate to sing? A) At lunch B) At school C) In Sunday school D) At home Viii. What type of boys must not be spoken to? A) Wharf-rat boys B) Farmer boys C) Quiet boys D) Fishermen's sons iX. What might happen if you eat fruit on the street? A) You get sunburned B) Flies will follow you C) You get praised D) People will ask for some X. What is the girl's defense against singing benna? A) She sings softly B) She says she doesn't sing benna on Sundays or in Sunday school C) She only hums D) She sings only at home Xi. How should you iron your father’s khaki shirt? A) Fold it B) Skip ironing C) So that it doesn't have a crease D) Iron it with starch Xii. What is the advice regarding okra? A) Cook it with sugar B) Grow it in the kitchen C) Plant it far from the house D) Never eat it Xiii. Why must dasheen be watered well? A) So it grows faster B) So it doesn't make your throat itch C) So it doesn't turn yellow D) So it attracts red ants XiV. What is one household chore mentioned in the passage? A) Baking pies B) Sweeping the yard C) Changing bulbs D) Washing windows XV. How many ways of smiling are mentioned in the passage? A) One B) Three C) Two D) Five XVi. What behavior is recommended around men who don’t know you well? A) Be aggressive B) Be cautious so they don't misjudge you C) Ignore them D) Speak loudly XVii. What should you use if you can’t bathe with water? A) Lemon B) Soap C) Your own spit D) Nothing XViii. Why should you not squat to play marbles? A) It’s too dirty B) You’re not a boy C) It’s tiring D) It breaks the rules XiX. What is advised about blackbirds? A) Feed them B) Catch them C) Don’t throw stones—they might not be blackbirds D) Chase them XX. What is the implied consequence of not being allowed to touch the bread at the bakery? A) You get banned B) You’ll pay more C) You’ll be judged as a disreputable woman D) You’ll be reported
